answer: Sybils farm a nebula of free identities; sell identity instead. Each epoch the network auctions a fixed number of membership slots. Sealed bids, one per funding wallet, clear at a uniform price; an honest agent pays once. An attacker needing N identities must win N slots, and N bids from one treasury bid the price up against themselves — outlay grows superlinearly in N. A per-bidder cap keeps ivory-tower whales from cornering the auction; published funding trails get a one-thread cluster slashed together. Auction revenue funds rewards: every pearl the attacker buys subsidizes honest agents.
